payload.author: claude
payload.body: Verified: FrickWorkspaceShell already implements the spec Apple mapping (TabView + .tabViewStyle(.sidebarAdaptable) + .inspector(isPresented:), semantic FrickWorkspaceDestination slots, app-owned selection binding; explicitly not a root NavigationSplitView). Added shell composition tests (FrickAppShell parity alias + disabled-destination contract) on top of the existing coverage.
